title: Low fat Carrot Cake
preamble:
6 oz (175 g) dark brown soft sugar, sifted

2 large eggs at room temperature

4 fl oz (120 ml) sunflower oil

7 oz (200 g) wholemeal self-raising flour

1½ level teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
ingredients: 6 oz (175 g) dark brown soft sugar, sifted
7 oz (200 g) carrots, peeled and coarsely grated
notes: You will also need a buttered oblong tin 8 inches by 10 inches, 1½ inches deep (20cm by 26cm, 4cm deep), with a liner
